description: Word-like document editor shell backed by the document editor JSON provider contracts.

parameters.name: AuditFailureMode
parameters.description: Determines whether activity provider failures block editor workflows.

parameters.name: ActivityProvider
parameters.description: Optional activity provider used to record document editor audit events.

parameters.name: Author
parameters.description: Whether a newer local draft should replace the server snapshot during load.

parameters.name: AutoSaveInterval
parameters.description: Whether provider-backed suggestions start enabled.

parameters.name: CanComment
parameters.description: Whether major versions require a non-empty description.

parameters.name: CanDeleteOwnComments
parameters.description: Whether the current user can resolve or reopen comment threads.

parameters.name: CanResolveComments
parameters.description: Whether the current user can add comments and replies.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Raised immediately before a save request is sent to the provider.

parameters.name: CollaborationClientId
parameters.description: Optional provider used to synchronize realtime collaborative edits.

parameters.name: CollaborationProvider
parameters.description: Optional proofing options used by the canvas engine spelling overlay.

parameters.name: CollaborationSyncInterval
parameters.description: Stable collaboration client id for the current editor instance.

parameters.name: ComparisonProvider
parameters.description: Optional host provider used to import and export external document formats.

parameters.name: ContentControlRenderMode
parameters.description: Provider-managed image assets that can be inserted from the editor image menu.

parameters.name: DisabledFeatures
parameters.description: Whether debug tools (View JSON etc.) are shown in the toolbar. Intended for development only.

parameters.name: FontProvider
parameters.description: Optional provider used to resolve template token values for preview.

parameters.name: FormatProvider
parameters.description: Optional host provider used to export the current document as PDF.

parameters.name: ImageAssetOptions
parameters.description: Optional image provider used by upload and clipboard image flows.

parameters.name: ImageProvider
parameters.description: Optional resolver for provider-managed document image assets.

parameters.name: ImageUrlResolver
parameters.description: Feature names that should be disabled for this editor instance.

parameters.name: ImageValidation
parameters.description: Canvas content-control rendering mode. Use form for plain fill mode or design for structured-tag chrome.

parameters.name: MentionProvider
parameters.description: Whether the current user can delete their own comments.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Host-controlled permissions for the current user.

parameters.name: OfflineMode
parameters.description: Interval used to poll provider-backed collaboration updates.

parameters.name: OnDocumentCompared
parameters.description: Raised after the optional document format provider returns an export result.

parameters.name: OnDocumentFormatExported
parameters.description: Raised after the optional PDF export provider returns a result.

parameters.name: OnDocumentLoaded
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.

parameters.name: OnPdfExported
parameters.description: Raised after a document version was created successfully.

parameters.name: OnSaveRequested
parameters.description: Raised immediately before a save request is sent to the provider.

parameters.name: OnVersionCreated
parameters.description: Raised after a document was loaded successfully.

parameters.name: PdfExportProvider
parameters.description: Optional provider for available editor font families.

parameters.name: Permissions
parameters.description: Whether the editor is read-only.

parameters.name: PreferLocalDraft
parameters.description: Optional provider used to submit an offline draft back to the authoritative store.

parameters.name: ProofingOptions
parameters.description: Optional provider used to store and review document suggestions.

parameters.name: Provider
parameters.description: Stable document id to load from the provider.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Document editor provider used for load/save/version/comment operations.

parameters.name: RequireMajorVersionDescription
parameters.description: Optional autosave interval. Set to null to disable autosave.

parameters.name: ShowComments
parameters.description: Visual mode used by the document editor toolbar.

parameters.name: ShowDebugTools
parameters.description: Whether the version history panel is displayed.

parameters.name: ShowToolbar
parameters.description: Current editor mode.

parameters.name: ShowVersionHistory
parameters.description: Whether the comments rail is displayed.

parameters.name: SigningFieldsChanged
parameters.description: Signer roles used to colour inline signing fields and to attribute placed fields (plan S2).

parameters.name: SuggestionProvider
parameters.description: Whether local comparison should be used if the comparison provider fails.

parameters.name: SuggestionsEnabled
parameters.description: Whether track changes starts enabled.

parameters.name: SyncProvider
parameters.description: Optional offline draft store used when is enabled.

parameters.name: TokenProvider
parameters.description: Optional mention provider reused by the comment composer.

parameters.name: TokenValueProvider
parameters.description: Optional token provider reused by the document token autocomplete menu.

parameters.name: ToolbarMode
parameters.description: Whether the Word-like toolbar/ribbon is displayed.

parameters.name: TrackChangesEnabled
parameters.description: Image validation options used by upload and clipboard image flows.

parameters.name: UseLocalComparisonFallback
parameters.description: Optional host provider used to compare arbitrary document sources.
